items.title: Florida Atlantic’s Messer Named a Burlsworth Trophy Nominee
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's fifth-year WR Easton Messer has been named one of 65 nominees for the 2026 Burlsworth Trophy, recognizing outstanding college football players who began their careers as walk-ons.

items.title: Inside the Owls’ Burrow S11, E12
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Inside the Owls' Burrow, the official weekly television show for Florida Atlantic Athletics, will air episode 11 of season 12 this week on Thursday, Nov. 5. Every 30-minute show this season will air on The Spot stations in the South Florida market.

items.title: University Press staff predict another hard-fought game versus UTSA
items.summary: Flashing lights, loud fans, an ESPN crew, and the American conference’s number one team will all be at the Flagler Credit Union Stadium on Thursday night. FAU will face the University of Texas at San Antonio (7-1, 4-0 AC) this Thursday, live on ESPN at 7:30 p.m., with Sportscenter on campus before the game, a...

items.title: Owls Hosting 'SportsCenter on Campus’ Before Thursday’s National TV Game vs. UTSA
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic is set to host ESPN's 'SportsCenter on Campus' on Thursday, Nov. 5, prior to the Owls hosting UTSA in a nationally televised football game on ESPN at 7:30 p.m.

items.title: Football Game Notes #9
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football is set for its second Thursday game in as many weeks, this time on Howard Schnellenberger Field at Flagler Credit Union Stadium with RV UTSA coming to town. The program's first regular season home game on the flagship station kicks off at 7:30 p.m.

items.title: Owls’ Football at Tulsa Announced for 3:30 p.m. on ESPN+
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football will face American Conference foe Tulsa on the road Saturday, Nov. 14, kicking off at 3:30 p.m. ET on ESPN+ as announced by the league on Monday.

items.title: Messer An American Honorable Mention
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's fifth-year WR Easton Messer continues to receive recognition from the American Conference, announced on Monday as a weekly Honorable Mention following his record-setting performance at North Texas.

items.title: Veltkamp Named East-West Bowl Monday Morning Quarterback
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Fresh off a standout performance at North Texas, Florida Atlantic football's graduate QB Caden Veltkamp was named the Shriner Children's East-West Bowl "Monday Morning Quarterback."

items.title: Weekly Coaches Show to Slated for Tuesday
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. - The Florida Atlantic Coaches Show, presented by Duffy's Sports Grill, will remain on Tuesday this week. The show on Nov. 3 takes place from 6 to 7 p.m. at the Duffy's Sports Grill on St. Andrew's Boulevard in Boca Raton.

items.title: Veltkamp and Doggette to Join Kittley on Weekly ESPN+ Presser
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic's Hagerty Family Head Football Coach Zach Kittley will be joined by graduate QB Caden Veltkamp and DL CJ Doggette Jr. for the Monday, Nov. 2 press conference, airing live on ESPN+ at 12 p.m.

items.title: Pads Off with Ben Galloway
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's senior OL Ben Galloway is featured in this week's "Pads Off", a segment hosted by Frank Forte where they talk anything but football.

items.summary: After winning four straight games for the first time in six years, Florida Atlantic football (4-2, 2-1 AC) suffered its first conference loss last week against Army (4-2, 3-1 AC).
